描述_EN: the surface decoration of spots of iron-brown glaze, however, was a popular technique that was used at many kilns across northern china during this period. the ewer is made with the hard, white clay used in the kilns that produced ding ware during the liao dynasty (907-1125). its has a complex shape, probably imitating metalwork, would have been composed of several parts which were thrown individually, and then put together before firing. this ewer was made in northern china around the late 11th or early 12th century.
描述_ZN: 表面的铁褐色釉点装饰，是这一时期中国北方许多窑场都在使用的流行技术。 该陶器是用辽代（907-1125年）生产鼎器的窑炉中使用的坚硬的白色粘土制成的。 其形状复杂，可能是模仿金属制品，应该是由几个部分组成的，这些部分被单独抛出，然后在烧制前被放在一起。 这个陶器大约在11世纪末或12世纪初在中国北方制造。
